prompt: Create a vertical watercolor fashion portrait of a stylish young woman with warm light skin and tousled dark brown hair shown from the chest up against a clean white paper background. She wears a wide-brim woven straw sun hat with visible circular stitch lines and loose sketchy ink outlines, round mirrored sunglasses reflecting a tropical beach scene with palm trees and blue sky, glossy red lipstick, silver hoop earrings, a crisp white button-up shirt, a faded light-blue denim jacket with detailed seams, buttons, chest pockets, and watercolor bleeds, plus a tan leather crossbody strap crossing diagonally over her shoulder. Pose her in a relaxed three-quarter view, head slightly tilted upward and turned to the side as if looking into bright sunlight, with loose strands of hair blowing around her face. Use an elegant mixed-media style: transparent watercolor washes, fine black ink contour lines, expressive splatters, soft skin shading, realistic facial proportions, detailed fabric texture, and airy negative space. Include scattered blue and warm brown paint splashes around the figure, especially near the hat and jacket, while keeping the background mostly white. Make the illustration refined, fashionable, summery, travel-inspired, and high-detail, with no text or watermark.
